newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark denies Portugal Telecom talk.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark denies Portugal Telecom talk.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark denied on Friday media reports that it was considering buying a 1.25 percent share in Portugal Telecom.
"In its present form such a purchase has no interest for us," Tele Danmark project director Torben Holm told Reuters.

Holm declined to comment further on recent stories in Spanish and Portuguese newspapers that Portugal Telecom might sell a 1.25 percent stake of its capital to the Danish firm as part of the third stage of its privatisation. --Carl Johan Corneliussen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33 96 96 58
